contract: Implemented the live issue body read from GitHub: keep the same on-page active Stop/Cancel icon, relocate to clear viewport space first, and minimize overlap only when every usable position is obstructed. This supersedes the upstream snapshot requesting a temporary extension-menu fallback.
implementation: Idle and error controls require a safe field-adjacent position, preferring the right. Hidden, clipped, covered and offscreen targets do not offer an idle mic.
Snapshot control geometry, include native/ARIA/custom controls and shadow hosts, inspect open shadow roots and page hit-testing, and reserve clearance for the mic shadow and focus ring.

For active sessions, sweep free viewport intervals including narrow pockets. When no clear position exists, minimize overlap among edge, corner, grid and obstacle-boundary candidates. Restore clear placement when space returns.

Preserve the same session, target and Stop/Cancel handler. Use the existing widget in the top layer when actual hit-testing detects stacking obstruction; move only this widget inside a modal when required to avoid modal inertness.
Keep status labels non-interactive, clamp to viewport, and visually clip unsafe labels while retaining live-region text.

Coalesce layout events and mutations with requestAnimationFrame, cache DOM discovery, snapshot geometry once per placement, and poll at 250 ms for movement without DOM mutations. Clean up pending work on disable.
coverage: Right-side preference; adjacent buttons; thin partial overlaps; native click-through; no host field wrapping or geometry changes.
Packed idle viewport; open and closed shadow controls; clipping and covered targets; narrow viewports, edges, zoom and scroll.
Style changes, CSS animation and shadow-root mutations.
Active viewport relocation, a narrow interior pocket, fully occupied Preparing/Cancel and Recording/Stop, safe-position recovery and a single widget.
Status label click-through; max-z-index overlays, later popovers and modal dialogs; keyboard Stop; focus and caret retention.
Existing consent, permission, offscreen ownership, independent Live/Web sessions, lifecycle cleanup and authenticated output tests.
validation_scope: Installed extension tests use native Chrome messaging, permissions and fake-device capture, with deterministic ASR worker fixtures. Real model inference was not rerun for this positioning change.
intermediate_findings: The first full run exposed removed-target error-state removal, fixed by retaining its hidden error widget. It also observed an extra fixture transcript chunk in the timing-sensitive rapid-cancel test; the targeted rerun and final full run both passed.
